title: YouTube Transcript with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required video_id input. Start performs one YouTube Transcript request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Transcript permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: An 11-character YouTube video ID, not a full URL.

language.title: Language
language.description: Requested language code. Does not translate content.

auto.description: true selects automatic captions; false selects uploader captions. No fallback.
auto.title: Auto
